Report Center
How Report Center Works ↗
Download full data exports. More reports will appear here over time.
Product Master — Full Export
One row per platform listing — SKU ID repeats across rows, a Platform column says which (Meesho/Flipkart/Amazon/Shopsy), shared columns for Catalog ID/Stock/URL/etc.
BOM — Full Export
One row per BOM — Output, Output Type, live cost per unit, then every ingredient as its own Ingredient N / Qty per Unit / Unit column set. Requires sign-in (BOM data is staff/owner-only).
Stock Batches — Full Export
One row per FIFO stock lot (batch) across every material — received date, source purchase/event, qty original, qty remaining, unit cost, status. Requires sign-in (stock data is staff/owner-only).
Rate Calculator
Enter what you paid for the product, then either type the price you plan to sell at or ask for a suggested price at a target profit — see exactly what Meesho/Flipkart/Amazon keep, and what profit actually lands in your pocket. Assumes Fashion/Imitation Jewellery category. Every default below is editable.
Sources (researched 2026-08-07 — platform fees change over time, re-verify before trusting blindly later): Meesho commission & RTO policy — supplier.meesho.com/pricing, /shipping (official). Amazon referral fee schedule — sell.amazon.in/fees-and-pricing/fee-schedule (official). Flipkart's own fee page is JS-gated and could not be independently fetched — its 0%-commission default is corroborated by real Rumee payment data + third-party seller guides, not independently official-confirmed. Real per-event return charges (Meesho ₹162, Flipkart ₹64) were read directly from real Meesho/Flipkart payment files this session — not yet persisted to Firestore, so they're seeded constants until the pipeline is extended to save them. Return rate (18–22%), packaging (₹3–5/pc), storage (₹0.50/pc, no authoritative source exists) are industry-benchmark estimates, not platform-official.

Return Unused Material
Every material given on this assignment, not just what the BOM estimate says is left -- a real batch can need more or less than the BOM ratio predicts. Enter qty for as many as apply, one Save logs all of them, capped only by what was actually given minus what's already been returned.

Correct Material Cost
For a materials_given row frozen at a genuinely wrong cost (e.g. no real stock lot existed yet when it was consumed) -- corrects only THIS assignment's own copy of the cost. Does not touch the material's real stock, and does not recost any finished-goods stock already posted using the old rate. Leaves a permanent audit note.

Correct Lot Cost
For a lot posted at a genuinely wrong cost (a data-entry mistake) -- corrects just the cost, doesn't touch qty. Leaves a permanent audit note. Never use this to "update" a price that was simply correct at the time -- lots are meant to keep their real historical cost.
